schema_sql: CREATE TABLE clipped_range (row_id BIGINT NOT NULL, x BIGINT NOT NULL)
original_sql: SELECT row_id FROM clipped_range WHERE (x <= -5 OR (x >= 1 AND x <= 10)) AND x >= 4
reference_sql: SELECT row_id FROM clipped_range WHERE x >= 4 AND x <= 10
derivation: The outer lower bound x >= 4 eliminates the x <= -5 branch and intersects the surviving interval [1, 10] with [4, maximum BIGINT]. The result is exactly [4, 10], with the original upper endpoint still required.
source: Team-derived variant of data/SQL_Predicate_Family_Examples.sql, C4 seed (C4-01): the outer bound both eliminates a branch and clips the lower end of the survivor.
error_exposed: Returning x >= 1 AND x <= 10 only removes the impossible branch but fails to clip the survivor, incorrectly including rows 5 and 6 (x = 1 and 3). Returning only x >= 4 also includes row 10 (x = 11) beyond the retained upper endpoint.
